changes: A movable Quick Callout panel shows your current named battleground area. Help, 1, 2 and 3+ buttons send a help request directly to battleground chat, including during combat.
The panel starts off. Enable Quick callout panel in Highground's Panels and features → Battleground, or /hgbg config. Preview it outside a match to save its position.
All clear tells teammates everything is okay at your location. Existing chat drafts stay intact, and a brief cooldown prevents accidental double sends.
notice: Restart the game after updating; this release adds a new file, so /reload is not enough. CurseForge files may still be in moderation.
